content.user_title: Build Avalonia Apps with Zafiro Patterns
content.value_statement: Avalonia projects can drift into inconsistent MVVM, reactive, and validation patterns. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code concrete Zafiro rules for maintainable cross-platform UI work.
actual_capabilities: Defines Avalonia UI rules for pure ViewModels, bindings, DataTemplates, and visual state usage.
Guides ReactiveUI and DynamicData pipeline choices for collections, filtering, sorting, binding, and lifecycle management.
Documents Zafiro shortcut methods for observables, Result values, Maybe values, commands, and interactions.
Promotes functional error handling with Result and Maybe types instead of exception-driven flow control.
Provides patterns for RefreshableCollection usage, validation rules, error handling, naming, and architecture decisions.
limitations: It provides development rules, not runnable project scaffolding or generated application code.
It assumes familiarity with Avalonia UI, C#, ReactiveUI, DynamicData, and the Zafiro toolkit.
It does not replace build validation, platform testing, accessibility review, or product-specific architecture decisions.
It focuses on Zafiro conventions and may not fit projects that intentionally avoid that toolkit.

prompt_templates.title: Review Basic ViewModel Rules
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner check for Avalonia MVVM separation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Avalonia ViewModel for Zafiro alignment. Focus on UI independence, naming rules, and exception boundaries.

prompt_templates.title: Choose Reactive Operators
prompt_templates.prompt: Given this reactive collection flow, suggest DynamicData and Zafiro operators that improve clarity, lifecycle handling, and binding behavior.

prompt_templates.title: Refactor Error Handling
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of command and validation flow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Refactor this Avalonia feature design to use Result, Maybe, ValidationRule, and HandleErrorsWith where they fit.

prompt_templates.title: Audit Architecture Consistency
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review before merging a feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this feature proposal against the Avalonia Zafiro rules. Identify violations, safer alternatives, and reusable extension opportunities.

output_examples.input: A ViewModel directly references Avalonia controls and handles errors with thrown exceptions.
output_examples.output: The review recommends moving UI details into bindings and templates, then returning Result values across feature boundaries.

output_examples.input: A collection view uses plain subscriptions to filter, sort, and update UI-bound lists.
output_examples.output: The review suggests a DynamicData pipeline with filtering, sorting, binding, and lifecycle disposal in one readable chain.

output_examples.input: A team wants consistent standards for a new Zafiro-based desktop application.
output_examples.output: The skill produces review criteria covering naming, static state, validation, Zafiro helper discovery, and reusable extension methods.

best_practices: Search for existing Zafiro helpers before creating new reactive or validation logic.
Keep ViewModels independent from Avalonia types and drive UI behavior through bindings and templates.
Use DynamicData and lifecycle disposal patterns for collection pipelines and side-effect subscriptions.
anti_patterns: Putting business logic inside Subscribe instead of using clear reactive transformations.
Using exceptions for expected flow control across architectural boundaries.
Creating local SourceList or SourceCache instances for problems that existing abstractions already solve.

faq.question: What does this skill help with?
faq.answer: It helps AI agents follow Avalonia, Zafiro, ReactiveUI, DynamicData, and functional MVVM conventions during coding tasks.

faq.question: Does it generate a complete Avalonia application?
faq.answer: No. It provides rules, review criteria, and implementation guidance for projects that already use these technologies.

faq.question: Can it help with code reviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It can check ViewModels, reactive pipelines, validation logic, naming, and error handling against the documented standards.

faq.question: Does it require the Zafiro toolkit?
faq.answer: Yes. The guidance is centered on Zafiro abstractions, shortcuts, validation helpers, and related coding conventions.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use it?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: Does it perform external commands?
faq.answer: No. The reviewed files contain documentation and Markdown examples, not executable scripts or command invocations.
